Let me look at the git history to understand what changed recently, and look at the fuzz driver. Let me check the git log and recent commits.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && git log --oneline -20 && echo "=====" && git diff HEAD~5 --stat 2>/dev/null | head -30</｜｜DSML｜｜>
